inputs.documented_behavior: validate/SKILL.md says to run bash .agent/scripts/apastra/validators/validate-dataset.sh <file> for promptops/datasets/*.jsonl.
inputs.runtime_behavior: promptops/validators/validate-dataset.sh prints Usage: validate-dataset.sh <manifest.json|yaml> <cases.jsonl> and exits 1 when called with one argument.
inputs.observed_failure: During integration, one-argument dataset validation failed even for valid JSONL cases. A temporary JSON manifest was required.

inputs.documented_behavior: Scaffold examples often use {"type":"is-json"} without a value for inline assertions.
inputs.runtime_behavior: promptops/schemas/dataset-case.schema.json requires each assertion object to include both type and value.
inputs.observed_failure: Existing example-shaped datasets failed validation until is-json assertions were written as {"type":"is-json","value":true}.

inputs.documented_behavior: docs/vision.md describes datasets as JSONL + manifests, while eval/SKILL.md says suite mode reads promptops/datasets/<dataset-id>.jsonl.
inputs.runtime_behavior: The actual suite-mode instructions and resolver expectations require flat JSONL files for suite dataset refs. Nested dataset directories validated manually but would not run by suite ID.
inputs.observed_failure: A worker created promptops/datasets/<id>/dataset.jsonl. The integration pass flattened it to promptops/datasets/<id>.jsonl.

inputs.documented_behavior: Apastra treats prompt specs, datasets, evaluators, and suites as durable Git source of truth; run artifacts are append-only evidence and often ignored or stored separately.
inputs.runtime_behavior: climatecentral.org/.gitignore ignored all promptops/ under an eval artifacts comment.
inputs.observed_failure: New suites existed locally but did not appear as normal untracked git changes until .gitignore was narrowed to promptops/runs/.
